summary: Amends CD-0093 D2 so a running session may create or claim its current work item's canonical worktree and persistently retarget later Concord operations to it while the host process directory stays unchanged. Same-Project cross-worktree access is tiered: read-only Inspect, exclusive-lease Verify with unchanged tracked files, typed-transfer Take over, and Destroy under its subject and occupancy gates. Operator consent and permanent-loss decisions follow CD-0243, not a blanket destructive-action approval. Targets derive from registered Project and work identity, possession grants no Product authority, and continuity re-pins the target and lease each turn with stale versions failing closed.
title: Allow in-session worktree retargeting under tiered authority
